description: Machine-readable gate definitions for AES-P1.3 (SUE-440). Prose form: quality-gates.md. Engine: scripts/lib/quality-gates-core.mjs. Severity — reject: blocks materialization. fix: must be resolved before review. flag: human judgement required.

gates.name: prompt-echo
gates.rationale: The instruction given to the generator was emitted as prose. Observed in the SUE-417 fixture as both the dek and the first body line.

gates.name: scaffolding-leak
gates.rationale: Planning notes, placeholders, or template markers shipped as content.

gates.name: citation-integrity
gates.rationale: Provenance pointing at a disposable working document is not provenance. Duplicate citations to one URL inflate the apparent evidence base.

gates.name: filler-phrase
gates.rationale: Openings and closings banned by voice.md. They occupy the two positions in a piece that carry the most weight.

gates.name: overclaim
gates.rationale: Absolute or certainty-asserting language that the evidence rarely supports.

gates.name: empty-hedge
gates.rationale: A hedge with no number and no citation states nothing. 'We do not know X' is precise; 'results may vary' is filler.
patterns: (다양하게 나타날 수 있다|경우에 따라 다를 수 있다)

gates.name: formulaic-sectioning
gates.rationale: Generic section framing applied mechanically rather than earned by the argument.

evidenceDensity.name: evidence-density
evidenceDensity.rationale: Fraction of body paragraphs carrying a number, a date, or a citation marker. Below this the piece is assertion rather than analysis.

sequentialSummary.name: sequential-summary
sequentialSummary.rationale: Most citing paragraphs draw on exactly one source and the sources appear in order — the shape of a source-by-source restatement rather than a synthesis.

protectedSpans.rationale: What a polish pass may never alter. This is what distinguishes polish from rewrite, and it is why no rule in voice.md takes the form 'vary sentence length to sound natural'.
